text: 下面进入小作文 05 · 告示 Notice：中外文化交流周学生志愿者招募答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：交代告示活动背景与明确招募名额。
In an effort to foster cross-cultural understanding on campus, this notice is issued for the purpose of recruiting 20 energetic and responsible student volunteers.
告示开篇标配：This notice is issued for the purpose of doing sth.。
This notice is issued for the purpose of recruiting student volunteers.
第二段：结构化列明应聘门槛与岗位职责。
Above all, applicants should demonstrate fluent oral English; in addition, the primary responsibilities entail guiding international guests and coordinating booths.
逻辑承接词三步法：Above all..., In addition..., The primary responsibilities entail...
The primary responsibilities entail guiding international guests and coordinating booths.
第三段：公布联系邮箱、报名截止时限与署名日期。
Those who are interested should submit an electronic application before November 20th, and we sincerely look forward to your active participation.
告示结语必背句：Those who are interested should do sth. before [Date].
We sincerely look forward to your active participation.
